cohort: The study included pregnancies diagnosed with Single Umbilical Artery (SUA) and Umbilical Artery Thrombosis (UAT) at a tertiary hospital between 2017 and 2021, along with a control group.
finding: Fetuses with Umbilical Artery Thrombosis (UAT) had significantly lower birth weight and higher rates of low birth weight, fetal growth restriction, preterm labor, and fetal distress compared with those with Single Umbilical Artery (SUA).
